pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.3: akataṃ kammaṃ dukkataṃ kammaṃ puna kātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭessantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.6: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.11: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.12.1: “yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ puna kammāya ukkoṭeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti, aññe vā tassa ārocenti, so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.8: dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ yathādhammaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.10: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.12: akataṃ kammaṃ dukkataṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbanti jānanto ukkoṭeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.3.2: adhammena vā vaggena vā na kammārahassa vā kammaṃ katanti jānanto ukkoṭeti
